cards.card_text: Solomon comes back to the proverb: in a fool's mouth, it's like a thorn that goes into the hand of a drunkard.

cards.card_text: Jesus says the word on Him is, "Look at this glutton and drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!" Friend, that's the coworker who complains the office is too cold on Monday and too HOT on Tuesday.

cards.card_text: Paul says the Corinthians can still share meals with someone who claims to be a brother but is greedy, a drunkard or a swindler.
cards.verse_text: But now I am writing you not to associate with anyone who claims to be a brother but is sexually immoral or greedy, an idolater or a verbal abuser, a drunkard or a swindler.
cards.snippet: …is sexually immoral or greedy, an idolater or a verbal abuser, a drunkard or a swindler.

cards.card_text: Then he lists who won't inherit the kingdom of God: the sexually immoral, idolaters, adulterers, men who submit to or perform homosexual acts, thieves, the greedy, drunkards, verbal abusers and swindlers.
cards.verse_text: Do not be deceived: Neither the sexually immoral, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor men who submit to or perform homosexual acts, nor thieves, nor the greedy, nor drunkards, nor verbal abusers, nor swindlers, will inherit the kingdom of God.
cards.snippet: …submit to or perform homosexual acts, nor thieves, nor the greedy, nor drunkards, nor verbal abusers, nor swindlers, will inherit the kingdom of God.
